message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine criminal charge(s) based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: Defendant Liu carried fire paper and lighter to perform ancestor worship, accidentally caused forest fire, burned 99.1 mu (~66 acres) of forest. He attempted to extinguish, called relatives to report, later police arrested. Likely crime: "违反森林防火管理条例" is administrative, but criminal: "放火罪" (arson) under Article 114 of Criminal Law, but need to see if qualifies as "非法放火罪" (arson) causing forest fire. In Chinese law, arson causing forest fire is "放火罪" (arson) if the fire results in serious consequences, such as large forest area. Also could be "过失致火灾罪" (negligent fire). Actually Chinese Criminal Law has "过失致人死亡罪" etc. For fire, there is "过失引发森林火灾罪" under Article 133? Let's recall: In 2011 amendment, there is "过失引发森林火灾罪" (negligent causing forest fire) under Article 133 of Criminal Law (maybe 133). The crime is "过失引发森林火灾罪" (negligent forest fire). The elements: by negligence, causing forest fire, causing loss. So likely charge: "过失引发森林火灾罪". Also could be "非法燃放烟花爆竹罪"? No.

Thus answer: [罪名]过失引发森林火灾罪<eoa>
